scope: Frozen native savanna scene, 32 worker rigs and 64 original/LOD lid meshes; ABBA then BAAB in one page. Shadows explicitly invalidated each frame. No simulation, animation advance, physics, camera movement or resource loading in measured blocks. GPU timer includes full world draw and its shadow pass; browser intervals are callback intervals. Not a live gameplay benchmark.
renderer: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 (0x00002184) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)
